Kerala UDF reverses stance on PM SHRI school scheme

Kerala's United Democratic Front (UDF) has decided to support the central government's PM SHRI school education scheme. UDF convener Adoor Prakash stated that governments operate in perpetuity and that the incumbent government cannot undo actions of the previous administration due to fiscal commitments. The UDF's decision follows the central government's allocation of crucial federal funding for school education under the scheme.
